how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-feralas-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:2766:obj:0: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot in a cave near Feral Scar Vale.
rows.quest:2766:details:0: You have uncovered some sort of strange, egg-shaped device made from metal. Fiddling with one of its knobs springs the egg to life, as it opens up into some sort of gnomish robotic contraption! A voice from inside the robotic egg crackles to life.
rows.quest:2766:details:1: B"My name's Oglethorpe Obnoticus, and my homing robot has crashed! I will reward you for its recovery; please take this beacon to the robot!"
rows.quest:2766:details:2: B"I now have computed the coordinates of the robot for you; it is in a cave near Feral Scar Vale!"
rows.quest:2766:completion:0: You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.
rows.quest:2766:completion:1: BHums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up. After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:
rows.quest:2766:completion:2: B"OOX-22/FE is working at least, but it needs major repairs! It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea. Are you up for watching over it some more?"
rows.quest:2767:obj:0: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:2767:details:0: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:
rows.quest:2767:details:1: B"I need to move OOX-22/FE to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure. It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again. Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the dock along the Forgotten Coast! That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"
rows.quest:2767:details:2: B"Escort it safely to the dock, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay! Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
rows.quest:2767:completion:0: Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-22/FE! I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!
rows.quest:2767:completion:1: BPlease, take your choice of any of these items I have. Thank you again for your generous assistance ⟦1⟧, my robots and I are in your debt!
rows.quest:2821:obj:0: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2821:details:0: My philosophy on leatherworking is that the work must be the best quality possible - no compromises. Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter is trying to sell you ocean-front property in ⟦E1⟧!
rows.quest:2821:details:1: BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have run across thick yeti hides. The Yeti are native to ⟦E2⟧, with many found in Feral Scar Vale. I want some, and I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten. If that sounds fair to you, then we're in business.
rows.quest:2821:completion:0: Did you stop and examine the texture of these hides? Properly treated, these hides could very well be stronger than iron. Not many people know about these hides, and that in combination with the vast treating solutions I know will allow me to potentially make items with a true mark of quality... thanks to you, of course!
rows.quest:2821:completion:1: BAnd now, please choose from what I am able to offer you for your service!
rows.quest:2822:obj:0: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2822:details:0: I take pride in my leather work, and I feel it shows; quality should never be compromised. Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter would also have you believe that the earth does not keep secrets!
rows.quest:2822:details:1: BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have discovered thick yeti hides. Yetis are native to ⟦E2⟧, often found west of here in Feral Scar Vale. I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten. If that is agreeable to you, then we are set!
rows.quest:2822:completion:0: Ah, excellent! These hides, when given a special treatment, are as resilient as iron I tell you! It will take many tries in order to get the right mix down for the tanning, but I am confident they will bring my mark of quality to the next level.
rows.quest:2822:completion:1: BAs for you, ⟦2⟧... your assistance has proven invaluable to me. Please take your choice from these items I have crafted.
rows.quest:2844:obj:0: Locate the lost night elf girl.
rows.quest:2844:details:0: I am no good, ⟦3⟧. I was 'spose to be watchin' over my little friend, Shay, and somehow, she got away from me. I'm not all that sure what happened, really, but last time I saw her, we was walkin' through the ruins just north of here.
rows.quest:2844:details:1: BEverythin' was goin' fine, but then I turned around, and... she was gone.
rows.quest:2844:details:2: BNow I jus can't quite figure out what I should do here. Got any ideas, ⟦4⟧? I'm awful worried.
rows.quest:2844:details:3: BHey, how 'bout you go look fer Shay? Yer legs can travel much faster 'n mine.
rows.quest:2844:completion:0: Oh, I am so glad you found me! I must admit, I am a bit lost... But isn't this a beautiful place?
rows.quest:2845:obj:0: Pick up Shay's Bell from the chest.
rows.quest:2845:obj:1: BEscort Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp.
rows.quest:2845:details:0: Do you think you could help me find my way back to my friend, Rockbiter? He was supposed to be watching me... But I do have a tendency to wander off now and then. There are just so many things to see, and I get so distracted.
rows.quest:2845:details:1: BThere is one thing that will always work to get my attention, though.
rows.quest:2845:details:2: BInside this chest, you'll find a bell that is very precious to me. I just love the sound of it. You have my word, if I wander off, all you have to do is ring it and I'll come running back.
rows.quest:2845:completion:0: What? You say dis bell will work when Shay runs off? Well, how 'bout that!
rows.quest:2845:completion:1: BSince you did so much fer me, here ya go, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:2862:obj:0: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2862:details:0: The gnolls... they are more than a nuisance. They are a constant threat to the existence of this very camp! It is irrelevant whether they are indigenous to ⟦E2⟧ or not; if we do not strengthen our resolve against them, we will find ourselves driven out of the entire region.
rows.quest:2862:details:1: BThe gnoll attacks against the camp have become more fevered as of late. We need your aid in thinning their numbers; bring to me ten of their manes, and I will reward you handsomely for your effort.
rows.quest:2862:completion:0: This is proof of a good start, ⟦6⟧. Your skills as a soldier are to be commended.
rows.quest:2862:completion:1: BYou are not the only one I ask that task of. Many before you have fought them, and in times past our efforts have kept them at bay. Recently though, their attempts to push northward into our area of influence have increased dramatically. Their attacks have also become more savage... almost as if they were desperate.
rows.quest:2862:completion:2: BI have a plan though, ⟦7⟧, that might settle things once and for all against them...
rows.quest:2863:obj:0: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.
rows.quest:2863:details:0: The plan is for various leaders of the gnolls - Alphas as they call themselves - to be taken down within rapid succession. If we're able to execute this sort of swift and precise devastation against them, it would cause chaos in their ranks. Perhaps it would also drive a message through their thick flea-bitten heads that we can and will destroy them!
rows.quest:2863:details:1: BI want you to be the messenger of my will; eliminate five of their Alphas within one hour for this to work ⟦8⟧, or we'll remain at this impasse!
rows.quest:2863:completion:0: You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you. Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:2863:completion:1: BWith their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp. This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...
rows.quest:2863:completion:2: BThere must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state. Before they have a chance to regroup though, I want to find out what is causing it.
rows.quest:2866:obj:0: Explore the Ruins of Solarsal and investigate the presence of the naga there.
rows.quest:2866:details:0: To our south are the Ruins of Solarsal; this is an area that far pre-dates modern times. We explored the ruins initially and found nothing of note; as such, we left it in peace.
rows.quest:2866:details:1: BVery recently, the Hatecrest naga have occupied these ruins in alarming numbers. At first, we considered it as the precursor for an attack. Though that threat is still possible, we believe there might be something else going on.
rows.quest:2866:details:2: BGo there, explore the ruins, and look for anything that stands out to you. Good luck, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:2866:completion:0: Examining the gazebo reveals some interesting and unusual things in contrast to the surrounding ruins.
rows.quest:2866:completion:1: BFirst, the gazebo is clearly a more recent construction than the other objects in the ruins. Second, the gazebo has a small series of glyphs engraved into the sides of it; the glyphs repeat in their pattern, but it otherwise is unknown in origin and meaning. Third, the stone of the gazebo itself is warm to the touch.
rows.quest:2866:completion:2: BThis certainly quantifies as "standing out" in the search of the ruins!
rows.quest:2867:obj:0: Return to Shandris Feathermoon in the Feathermoon Stronghold and report your findings.
rows.quest:2867:details:0: With the discovery of the strange gazebo in the heart of the Ruins of Solarsal, the time has come to return to Feathermoon Stronghold and report to General Shandris Feathermoon what has been discovered here.
rows.quest:2867:completion:0: Welcome back, ⟦11⟧. Your report on this gazebo is most... disturbing. It would seem that even if the naga there were not planning on an attack, their continued presence bodes ill for our push into ⟦E2⟧. At any rate, here is compensation for your investigation.
rows.quest:2867:completion:1: BIt would seem that Feathermoon Stronghold is in dire need of additional assistance concerning the Hatecrest naga. I'd like to offer you the task, if you are so inclined. There is much to do.
rows.quest:2869:obj:0: Bring 10 Hatecrest Naga Scales to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2869:details:0: The best course of action at this point is to assume that, regardless of what the naga are up to, they will eventually move to secure the island for their own. We need to take aggressive steps to counter that threat before it is too late.
rows.quest:2869:details:1: BBring me ten Hatecrest Scales that are in good condition; it should be obvious to you how to acquire them. You'll cut your teeth on the naga for the first time, and we'll have a weakened naga presence on Sardor Isle - both are prospects that play to our advantage.
rows.quest:2869:completion:0: Yes, yes, these scales are more than satisfactory. Actually, I think I will send these down to Pratt for him to take a look at. Maybe he can craft something useful out of them.
rows.quest:2869:completion:1: BAs for you, I have another mission I want to send you on. But first, here is your bounty for the scales. Your continued service to the General and Feathermoon Stronghold at large is a blessing in the face of adversity.
rows.quest:2870:obj:0: Eliminate Lord Shalzaru, and then bring the Mysterious Relic he uncovered to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2870:details:0: ⟦12⟧, new scouting reports have given us a good idea on the naga chain of command. Royalty is present amongst their rank and file, and they're the ones calling all the shots.
rows.quest:2870:details:1: BSpecifically, we've identified one of the crueler royals as Lord Shalzaru. Scouts report that he himself has uncovered an odd relic during a recent naga excavation in a cave south of the main ruins, across the water on the Isle of Dread.
rows.quest:2870:details:2: BPut a stop to it by putting a stop to him, and bring me his relic so we can study it.
rows.quest:2870:completion:0: Well played, ⟦13⟧! Lord Shalzaru's demise will throw the naga into disarray for some time, if not permanently. The threat they pose is now under more of our control than it has ever been, and we have you to thank for it.
rows.quest:2870:completion:1: BHere is more bounty money from the stronghold treasury - you've earned every copper. You and yours are welcome in Feathermoon Stronghold anytime, my friend.
rows.quest:2870:completion:2: BOne more thing before you depart, ⟦14⟧... if you could...
rows.quest:2871:obj:0: Deliver the Mysterious Relic to Vestia Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2871:details:0: If you would be so kind as to deliver the relic to my wife Vestia, I would appreciate it. She's not only a fine priestess for our community, but she is one of the most well-versed scholars you'll find anywhere. I couldn't make heads or tails of this device even if there was a wager involved. My wife though, if anyone can figure out what this thing is, she could... and we need to know!
rows.quest:2871:details:1: BShe's just around the bend, no doubt studying. Thanks, ⟦15⟧.
rows.quest:2871:completion:0: Interesting... this came from the Ruins of Solarsal, you say? Well, Latro's right that I need to look at this. At first glance, it seems non-indigenous to the ruins. Then again, this isn't of naga design... not something as alien as this.
rows.quest:2871:completion:1: BIt is going to take some time to research this item. Once my research on it is done, maybe I will make use of your talents, should you be around.
rows.quest:2871:completion:2: BHere, take one of these extra items we have; I hope you'll find some use for it!
rows.quest:2879:obj:0: Energize Troyas' Stave and find the Equinex Monolith.
rows.quest:2879:details:0: This stave might be the Stave of Equinex! The Stave of Equinex is actually a key, used to unlock the Equinex Monolith in the Ruins of Ravenwind, on the mainland west of the Dream Bough.
rows.quest:2879:details:1: BFind the four flames that still burn in those ruins: Samha, Imbel, Byltan, and Lahassa. Retrieve their essence and then while standing by the Equinex Monolith, use the essences to energize the stave. If this is truly is the Stave of Equinex, you will be able to unlock the Monolith and gather a sacred artifact from it.
rows.quest:2879:completion:0: Holding the energized stave is almost impossible. Its power rumbles through your body.
rows.quest:2879:completion:1: BYou reach out to the cold surface of the Equinex Monolith...
rows.quest:2879:completion:2: BA small door opens, allowing you to reach in and take the artifact inside.
rows.quest:2879:completion:3: BBeams of light fill the area around the Equinex Monolith.
rows.quest:2902:obj:0: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2902:details:0: Gnolls aren't the sharpest tools in the shed, but they will no doubt have some sort of documented strategy on their recent activity. If we were to find those plans, then we'd have a clearer idea of what is making them so worked up.
rows.quest:2902:details:1: BI want you to head back to the Woodpaw and find anything that might resemble their battle plans. They have to have something; their attacks have been too coordinated to be done without them. Find them, and return to me when you have them.
rows.quest:2902:completion:0: Examining the map reveals it to be the battle plans that Hadoken Swiftstrider wants. Numerous arrows that perhaps represent troop movements are drawn on the map, though most seem to be headed toward the south rather than to the north where Camp Mojache lies.
rows.quest:2902:completion:1: BAnother section of the map has a picture of what you think is a large insect of some kind, with various tick marks under it. From the looks of the gnolls, it perhaps represents their losses against the unknown bugs...
rows.quest:2903:obj:0: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2903:details:0: With the battle plans of the gnolls discovered, all that now remains is to bring the plans back to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache. Perhaps he or someone there can make further sense of what the gnolls are up to.
rows.quest:2903:completion:0: Ah, this is exactly what we needed. While I am not so skilled at ciphering what most of the scrawling on this map is, I've seen enough battle plans in my day to understand what is happening with the gnolls. It looks like they are currently fighting a two front war. One is with us... but it seems that their main energy has been against a foe to their south.
rows.quest:2903:completion:1: BThere's more at hand here than meets the eye. Perhaps it is time to figure out who this other foe they face really is.
rows.quest:2939:obj:0: Talk to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.
rows.quest:2939:details:0: While the ruins of ⟦E2⟧ can be quite dangerous, they have much to tell of what has happened here.
rows.quest:2939:details:1: BSearching through the rubble to the south a few days ago, I discovered what appears to be a normal stave. However, I just can't shake the feeling that there is something more to it. Angelas and I have been poring over our books here, but we can't find a thing about it.
rows.quest:2939:details:2: BI have a colleague in ⟦E3⟧ that may be able to tell us what this is, ⟦16⟧. Why don't you go talk to her and see if she can help us?
rows.quest:2939:completion:0: Oh, so Troyas Moonbreeze sent you?
rows.quest:2939:completion:1: B⟦17⟧...always bothering me with his wild notions that he found something important...
rows.quest:2939:completion:2: BLook, ⟦18⟧, I'll be blunt. Troyas always thinks he has found something important in those ruins. The truth is, anything that was truly valuable was probably hoarded away long ago by the ogres or the harpies that now reside there.
rows.quest:2939:completion:3: BYou're welcome to take a look around, but I don't know if you'll find any books here that will help you.
rows.quest:2940:obj:0: Ask Daryn Lightwind if you may borrow her book.
rows.quest:2940:details:0: This book looks as if no one has opened it for quite a long time. Its covers are quite worn, and its pages yellowed, but after examining it, you notice that it might be just what Troyas is looking for.
rows.quest:2940:details:1: BYou pick it up, but realize you should probably ask before borrowing it.
rows.quest:2940:completion:0: So, you'd like to borrow ⟦E2⟧: A History?
rows.quest:2940:completion:2: BI will allow you to borrow this book, ⟦19⟧, but only if you do something for me first.
rows.quest:2941:obj:0: Take the letter to Curgle Cranklehop in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:2941:details:0: I have studied many subjects in my time, and my latest fascination is with the snapjaw that occupy the beach in the Hinterlands. There's one in particular I'd like to see, a giant snapjaw named Gammerita. I'd like to go myself, but my research keeps me here. I think a picture of her would be the next best thing.
rows.quest:2941:details:1: BTake this letter to Curgle Cranklehop in ⟦E4⟧. She has created an invention for me that can capture a picture. She called it a "snapshot", I think...
rows.quest:2941:completion:0: Are you another one of Daryn's interns? She's quite a knowledgeable historian, ⟦20⟧. You should be grateful to be studying under her leadership.
rows.quest:2941:completion:1: BNow, let me get the Super Snapper FX. You're gonna love it!
rows.quest:2942:obj:0: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2942:details:0: The moment the artifact is removed from the Monolith, you feel the energy in the Stave of Equinex begin to fade.
rows.quest:2942:completion:0: I have been reading since you left, ⟦21⟧. This stone you have found is called the Morrow Stone. While I am not entirely sure what its purpose is yet, you can be sure that it is something of great significance to be hidden away inside the Equinex Monolith the way it was.
rows.quest:2942:completion:1: BI will continue my studies, and I hope I will be able to count on you in the future, ⟦22⟧. Thank you for all your help.
rows.quest:2943:obj:0: Deliver the book to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2943:details:0: Here it is, ⟦23⟧. Please, take care of my book.
rows.quest:2943:details:1: BNow, hurry along. I'm sure Troyas is eager for your return.
rows.quest:2943:completion:0: You have brought a book along. Excellent!
rows.quest:2944:obj:0: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.
rows.quest:2944:details:0: Have the first look at my new invention, ⟦24⟧. All you need to do is target whatever it is you'd like to take a picture of, and push the button.
rows.quest:2944:details:1: BWhat was that creature from the Hinterlands that you mentioned? Gammerita? Well, good luck finding her. I'm sure Daryn will be quite pleased with the snapshot you return to her.
rows.quest:2944:details:2: BIn any case, here's the Super Snapper. Have fun!
rows.quest:2944:completion:0: Well! Curgle's invention lived up to its expectations.
rows.quest:2944:completion:1: BDon't get too excited, but do know that I am pleased with your work, ⟦25⟧.
rows.quest:2944:completion:2: BNow, where did I leave that book...
rows.quest:2969:obj:0: Using the Bamboo Cage Key, free the Sprite Darters from the pen in the Grimtotem camp. At least 6 Sprite Darters and Kindal Moonweaver must survive.
rows.quest:2969:obj:1: BYou have 6 minutes before Kindal decides it is time to retreat and you fail the quest.
rows.quest:2969:details:0: The filthy Grimtotem clan are capturing faerie dragons, ⟦26⟧. Jer'kai and I have no idea what they plan on doing with them, but they're obviously up to no good.
rows.quest:2969:details:1: BWe're not powerful enough to fight our way into the camp and free the captured dragons, but perhaps with your help...
rows.quest:2969:details:2: BIf you're willing, and you have some strong friends, release the creatures from their cage with this key and make sure they escape with their lives. I'll be by your side the entire time. Jer'kai will remain here.
rows.quest:2969:completion:0: Thank ⟦E5⟧, ⟦27⟧! You are a great blessing to us and to the darters you saved. Jer'kai and I would never have been able to help the dragons ourselves--your intervention in the Grimtotem's affairs will be remembered.
rows.quest:2969:completion:1: BSpeak to Jer'kai now... I have to prepare for our retribution. Just because the faerie dragons are free, it doesn't mean they will remain so. Jer'kai and I will now go on the offensive.
rows.quest:2970:obj:0: Kill 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, and 6 Grimtotem Shamans before returning to Jer'kai Moonweaver in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2970:details:0: As she's already told you, Kindal and I will now take the fight to the Grimtotem. Together, we should still be able to pick off some of the tauren without much threat to ourselves, but we'd love some help if you're willing and able.
rows.quest:2970:details:1: BYou've seen the camp below us, but there are more to the east. Using your own tactics, deal as much damage to the tauren as you can. We can all meet back here after they've felt the sting of Kindal's arrows and your own weapons.
rows.quest:2970:completion:0: Kindal was right about you, ⟦28⟧--you do have a knack for this. You are a more seasoned adventurer than the both of us, and for that we thank you.
rows.quest:2970:completion:1: BThe Grimtotem clan is much more hostile than most tauren... I wonder if their own kind frowns upon their actions. I wouldn't be surprised. As you are probably aware, many races on ⟦E6⟧ have ties to less kindly counterparts.
rows.quest:2970:completion:2: BBut that is a discussion for another day.
rows.quest:2972:obj:0: Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:2972:details:0: Out here in the wilderness, Kindal and I have meager means to reward your help, but we don't want you to feel unappreciated. Take my signet ring. If you ever find yourself in the boughs of ⟦E7⟧, go to the Temple of the Moon in the heart of ⟦E3⟧. There you will find my High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. The ring will let her know that we are well and give credit to your story.
rows.quest:2972:completion:0: That's an amazing story, ⟦30⟧. It pleases us that you've not only helped dragonkind, but also one of our own priestess. Jer'kai was right to send you to me. I will make sure she has her ring returned to her--I have scouts heading the direction of ⟦E2⟧ soon. This will be one more thing for them to investigate while on their mission.
rows.quest:2972:completion:1: BThank you again, and please, make yourself at home while you're here.
rows.quest:2973:obj:0: Bring 10 Iridescent ⟦E8⟧ Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2973:details:0: Well met, ⟦31⟧. I've traveled with my companions down to the ⟦E2⟧ on a mission for our ⟦E9⟧ masters.
rows.quest:2973:details:1: BMy life-mate Korrin finds great pleasure in new clothing, so I aim to make her a new cloak adorned with the gossamer wings of faerie dragons. Would you be able to help me? Sprite darters with gorgeous wings I want are west of Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2973:completion:0: Wonderful, ⟦32⟧! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! Thank you.
rows.quest:2973:completion:1: BI hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of ⟦E2⟧ is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.
rows.quest:2974:obj:0: Bring 20 Grimtotem Horns to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2974:details:0: What!? You came across tauren in the area? You're joking! What did they look like!?
rows.quest:2974:details:1: BThe Grimtotem clan! You found some of them? Belgrom, one of our masters, has an interest in their kind... he's even put a bounty on them.
rows.quest:2974:details:2: BYou have to go back, ⟦34⟧. Go back and bring me their horns... piles of them if you can. The Grimtotem are not to be trifled with or underestimated. Go back and slay them; let the rivers in ⟦E2⟧ run red with their dark blood.
rows.quest:2974:completion:0: These are good horns, ⟦35⟧. Well done. I'll take these from you and be sure to tell Belgrom as soon as we return to ⟦E9⟧. You've helped me twice now, and for that, you have my mark. Perhaps in the future I can help you! Good luck to you.
rows.quest:2975:obj:0: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.
rows.quest:2975:details:0: The effects of the Gordunni Ogre tribe can hardly go unnoticed in this area. Look around, ⟦36⟧; their very presence scars this land. We must push them back before they expand even further into ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2975:details:1: BFollow the river north, and you will find their outpost. Decrease their numbers, ⟦37⟧. We must show them that their kind is not wanted here.
rows.quest:2975:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦38⟧. In time, the land will heal. We must not give up.
rows.quest:2976:obj:0: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:2976:details:1: BAh, so I did mention a bounty, didn't I? Well, that'll teach me to open my mouth, won't it?
rows.quest:2976:details:2: BYou did the work, so I suppose it is only right you reap the greatest reward from it. Take the horns, I'll have them put in a crate for you. Find Belgrom Rockmaul in the Valley of Honor, he'll want to know what you saw and he'll reward you for your hard work.
rows.quest:2976:details:3: BBe well, ⟦39⟧, and thank you again for everything you've done.
rows.quest:2976:completion:0: The Grimtotem!? This is interesting. You say you came across them while hunting in ⟦E2⟧? Truly?
rows.quest:2976:completion:1: BMy peers will want to hear your news, ⟦40⟧. Tell me more and I'll count out your coin while you do so.
rows.quest:2976:completion:2: BAnd before you go, know that I give you thanks for the information you've passed on to me this day.
rows.quest:2978:obj:0: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2978:details:0: Picking up the soiled scroll, you notice that it seems to be depicting some sort of meeting or ceremony. Rok Orhan would be interested in this scroll, and what it might mean to the Gordunni.
rows.quest:2978:completion:0: This scroll... You found this in the Gordunni Outpost?
rows.quest:2979:obj:0: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to find a Gordunni Orb.
rows.quest:2979:details:0: These seem to be plans for some sort of dark ceremony, ⟦41⟧. From what I can make out, this ritual is conducted by the Gordunni mage-lords.
rows.quest:2979:details:1: BFind one of these mage-lords, and from him, gather an orb.
rows.quest:2979:details:2: BThe orb of a mage contains great power, and will help us discover more about this ceremony and the magic that the Gordunni wield.
rows.quest:2979:completion:0: This orb will provide us with more information about the Gordunni... which we will then use in planning their downfall, ⟦42⟧.
rows.quest:2980:obj:0: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni ⟦E10⟧, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.
rows.quest:2980:details:0: Now that you have proven that you are a true fighter, I trust that you possess the courage to continue with the task at hand.
rows.quest:2980:details:1: BTravel to the High Wilderness, southwest of here. There lie some abandoned and destroyed structures, on land that once belonged to the night elves. Look for these ruins, and when you see the withered trees and desecrated terrain, you will find the Gordunni. Push them back.
rows.quest:2980:details:2: BThese ogres are much stronger than the ones you faced previously, ⟦43⟧. Be aware.
rows.quest:2980:completion:0: You have proven yourself to be a trustworthy and dependable ally, ⟦44⟧.
rows.quest:2982:obj:0: Angelas Moonbreeze wants you to kill 8 Gordunni Warlocks, 8 Gordunni ⟦E10⟧, and 8 Gordunni Brutes.
rows.quest:2982:details:0: Although it is dangerous, Troyas and I have been investigating the ruins that cover the forests of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2982:details:1: BLately, though, Troyas has been going on his own to the High Wilderness, and I really worry about him. The Gordunni Ogres have taken over that area, and they don't take kindly to anyone that enters their territory.
rows.quest:2982:details:2: BI was hoping you might be willing to travel to the ruins to the southeast and clear out some of the ogres. Make it a little safer for my Troyas, and I will be extremely grateful.
rows.quest:2982:completion:0: I am very grateful you were able to do this for me.
rows.quest:2982:completion:1: BNow, please, don't mention a word to Troyas about this...
rows.quest:2987:obj:0: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
rows.quest:2987:details:0: I just arrived here in ⟦E2⟧, and I've heard that the Gordunni Ogres that inhabit the wilds here have some interesting minerals. Who knows what they are up to, but they sure are protective of that stuff! They don't leave it just lying around; no, they bury it to protect folks like me from getting their hands on it.
rows.quest:2987:details:1: BIf you'd be willing, I'll give you my shovel. Go to the Gordunni Outpost north of here and dig me up some Gordunni cobalt. Look for the blue glow, then start digging!
rows.quest:2987:completion:0: Perfect! I will take these along as I continue my travels, ⟦45⟧. I'm sure I can find someone that will pay a pretty penny for this cobalt.
rows.quest:2987:completion:1: BHere, take this for your trouble.
rows.quest:3002:obj:0: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:3002:details:0: Although I know my enemy well, I am a warrior, ⟦46⟧. I cannot begin to tell you what this orb is capable of.
rows.quest:3002:details:1: BI know of a mage in ⟦E9⟧ that will be able to tell us more about the orb. Take it to him.
rows.quest:3002:completion:1: BThis orb is very powerful, but also very dangerous.
rows.quest:3062:obj:0: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.
rows.quest:3062:details:0: Edana Hatetalon is the queen of the Northspring harpies that reside in the ruins to the west. She is pure evil; I have heard that her heart is one of crystal. She is void of any emotion aside from the hate she feels towards all others. You must face Edana and bring me back her dark heart.
rows.quest:3062:details:1: BI have heard of a horn that harpies carry -- blowing it by the Hatetalon stones, in the northern part of the ruins, will summon the queen.
rows.quest:3062:details:2: BImagine her surprise when it is not her kin calling her, but her death.
rows.quest:3062:completion:0: Now I know that Edana is truly dead. This heart; I will keep it in memory of what did here for me, ⟦48⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:3063:obj:0: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.
rows.quest:3063:details:0: In my day, I was a seasoned hunter. There wasn't any creature around that I feared. Until...
rows.quest:3063:details:1: BI was out in the forest, sharpening my blade after a tough battle, when I was ambushed. Harpies surrounded me, and I barely managed to drag myself to safety.
rows.quest:3063:details:2: BEven now, I can still hear their cries echoing...
rows.quest:3063:details:3: BI was never the same after that. But the hate boils inside of me -- I must get even, after all these years.
rows.quest:3063:details:4: BThe Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. ⟦49⟧, get my revenge.
rows.quest:3063:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦50⟧. You have put an old tauren's mind at peace.
rows.quest:3121:obj:0: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:3121:details:0: Neeru Fireblade in ⟦E9⟧ has what I need to get started here! He has mixed up a concoction that I need for my... well, you'll see.
rows.quest:3121:details:1: BOff with you now -- to ⟦E9⟧. Here, take this with you. It's a shrunken head that I promised Neeru in exchange for the herbs. It's the head of some poor dwarf I ventured across in the forest. I'm sure Neeru will be pleased.
rows.quest:3121:details:2: BYou'll find Neeru in the Cleft of Shadow.
rows.quest:3121:completion:0: I have been waiting for Uzer'i to deliver this...
rows.quest:3121:completion:1: BLet me give you the herb mixture I prepared for his... well, experiments...
rows.quest:3122:obj:0: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:3122:details:0: Here are the herbs, ⟦51⟧. Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
rows.quest:3122:details:1: BPlease let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.
rows.quest:3122:completion:0: This is just what I need to prepare the muisek vessel, ⟦52⟧. Soon we will see if my latest incantations prove to be as powerful as I had hoped.
rows.quest:3122:completion:1: BPlease, a moment. I must perform the ritual and apply the herbs.
rows.quest:3123:obj:0: ⟦E11⟧ to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.
rows.quest:3123:obj:1: BBring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:3123:details:0: This will be a test; both of the ritual I performed, and of your abilities. Take this vessel, ⟦53⟧. With it, you will have the power to shrink and capture a creature inside of it.
rows.quest:3123:details:1: BTravel to the Hinterlands and look for creatures known as Wildkin that were once pets of the night elf goddess ⟦E5⟧. The vicious, primitive, or savage owlbeasts are your targets, ⟦54⟧. Kill 10, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.
rows.quest:3123:completion:0: Upon a violent death, the muisek of a creature may escape and seek revenge. Shrinking the creatures, as you did, ⟦55⟧, prevents the muisek from escaping. Now we may use it as we please!
